facts.text: Evan has been painting for a few years and finds it helpful for finding peace.

evidence.quote: I've been doing it for a few years now and it helps me find peace.

facts.text: Evan recommends painting as a way to relieve stress and be creative, but acknowledges it won't help with weight loss.

evidence.quote: Painting is a great way to relieve stress and be creative... But unfortunately it won't help you with your weight problem.

facts.text: Sam expresses appreciation for Evan's encouragement and intends to try painting.

evidence.quote: Thanks, Evan! Appreciate the encouragement. I'll give it a go and let you know how it turns out.

facts.text: Evan encourages Sam to enjoy painting without pressure and to keep him updated on progress.

evidence.quote: Have fun with it and don't put too much pressure on yourself. Can't wait to hear how it's going!
